title_zh: 正向童年經驗與成年早期心理健康的長期追蹤研究
title_en: Positive childhood experiences reduce risk of later mental illness: longitudinal cohort
summary_zh: 縱向追蹤研究（發表於 American Journal of Psychiatry，2026 年 10 月 14 日，doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007）。正向童年經驗（PCE）分數每增加 1 分（最高 10 分），成年早期符合精神障礙準則的機會率下降約 11%。
summary_en: Longitudinal study published in the American Journal of Psychiatry on 14 October 2026 (doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007). Each one-point increase in positive childhood experiences (PCE, up to 10) was associated with about 11% lower odds of meeting criteria for a psychiatric disorder in early adulthood, after adjusting for confounders.
evidence_note: 縱向觀察性研究；數據來自 APA Psychiatric News 報導，引用 AJP 原文 DOI
caution: 數據引自報導；如需引用，請以 AJP 原文核對。
brief_zh: PCE 分數與成年早期精神障礙風險呈負相關（每 1 分約 11%）
結果為觀察性關聯，不能推斷因果

related.title_zh: 針對懲教人員的診斷專屬網上認知行為治療：隨機對照試驗
related.title_en: Diagnosis-specific online CBT for correctional staff: randomised controlled trial
related.summary_zh: 隨機對照試驗，以懲教人員為對象比較診斷專屬網上認知行為治療（eCBT）與常規照顧（TAU）。eCBT 組症狀嚴重度下降 61.37%，TAU 組為 23.29%，效果量 Cohen's d=0.68，混合線性模型顯示組間差異具統計意義。
related.summary_en: Randomised controlled trial comparing diagnosis-specific online CBT (eCBT) with treatment as usual (TAU) among correctional staff. Symptom severity fell 61.37% in the eCBT group versus 23.29% in TAU (Cohen's d=0.68), with significant group differences in mixed linear models. Authors are from Providence Care Hospital, Canada.

related.title_zh: 短程 EMDR 用於人格障礙：荷蘭 RCT 顯示五週十次後症狀與診斷狀態改善
related.title_en: Brief EMDR for personality disorders RCT
related.summary_zh: Mental Elf 評介一項荷蘭兩所門診的隨機對照試驗（JAMA Network Open, 2025）：159 名人格障礙成人隨機分到 EMDR（每週兩次、共十次 90 分鐘）或候補名單。三個月追蹤時，以 ADP-IV 衡量 EMDR 組 44.1% 不再符合人格障礙標準，控制組 15.8%；人格障礙症狀、人格功能與情緒調節亦改善，中止率僅 5.1%、未報告不良事件。評論者提醒對照組是候補名單、追蹤期短。
related.summary_en: A Mental Elf blog reviews a Dutch RCT (JAMA Network Open, 2025) in which 159 adults with personality disorders received ten 90-minute EMDR sessions over five weeks or waiting list. At three-month follow-up, 44.1% of the EMDR group no longer met PD criteria on the ADP-IV versus 15.8% of controls, with gains in PD symptoms, personality functioning and emotion regulation, 5.1% dropout and no reported adverse events. The reviewer notes the waiting-list comparator and short follow-up.

related.title_zh: 世界心理健康日前夕，台灣心理健康聯盟提「不平等」三層解方
related.title_en: Taiwan Mental Health Alliance's three-level fix for inequality
related.summary_zh: 公視報導，台灣心理健康聯盟在 10/10 世界心理健康日前夕，提出解決心理健康不平等的三層解方：上游從經濟安全、平等包容消除歧視與汙名，中游以系統與政策提供可近資源，下游讓個人有穩定身心健康與歸屬感。國衛院副院長陳為堅提醒，不處理上游風險因子，只靠末端用藥會持續產生問題；衛福部心理健康司司長陳柏熹表示，將規劃把癌友納入免費心理諮詢補助，近期上路。
related.summary_en: Ahead of World Mental Health Day, the Taiwan Mental Health Alliance proposed upstream (economic security, anti-stigma), midstream (accessible services and policy) and downstream (individual wellbeing and belonging) solutions to mental health inequality. The Ministry said cancer patients will soon be included in its free counselling subsidy.
